body.name: \(d_\pi,d_*,\Pi_S^{(\tau)},\Theta_S^{(\tau)}\)
body.construction: For each \(\pi\in\mathfrak S_V\), define \(d_\pi=\max_{a\ne b\in S,\,i\ne j\in V}|R_\pi^{ab}[i,j]|/\sqrt{R_\pi^{aa}[i,i]R_\pi^{bb}[j,j]}\) and \(d_*=\min_{\pi\in\mathfrak S_V}d_\pi\). For \(\tau\ge0\), define \(\Pi_S^{(\tau)}=\{\pi\in\mathfrak S_V:d_\pi\le\tau\}\) and \(\Theta_S^{(\tau)}=\{T_\pi:\pi\in\Pi_S^{(\tau)}\}\), with numerical duplicates removed. The case \(\tau=0\) equals the maintained exact compatibility objects.
